tips: Approach steaming shallow pools to refill water before dehydration sets in.
Volcanic ash storms cut visibility—build a basic shelter early.
Stay clear of red meteor impact rings; fresh impacts often leave Primordial Crystals.
Body temperature spikes near lava rivers. Equip a Heat Shield when crossing rifts.
Toxic volcanic gas gathers near active craters—watch your oxygen gauge closely.

onboarding.slide1Body: No plants, no animals, no other humans exist yet. Only bare basalt plains, steaming shallow oceans, meteor showers, and active volcanoes.
onboarding.slide2Body: Desktop: WASD move, Mouse orbit camera, Space jump, Shift sprint, E interact, I inventory, B build shelter. Mobile: touch joystick & action buttons.
onboarding.slide3Body: Track 5 vital meters: Health, Stamina, Body Temperature, Oxygen, and Hydration. Gather basalt, minerals, crystals, and water to craft survival gear.
onboarding.slide4Body: PRIMORDIA detected your hardware and selected a balanced graphics preset for smooth 3D playback. You can adjust this anytime in Settings.
